task: messy behaviour idea to canonical local KernelSpec JSON
system: Convert the behaviour idea into one compact JSON object with exactly these keys: trigger, state, update, action, failure. Preserve unusual mechanics. Use only local sensing and bounded state. Output JSON only.

train.input: When something shoves the bot, it gets weirdly attached to the direction the shove came from for a little while, then gradually gets over it.

output.update: store impulse direction in push_dir; set echo=1; decay echo each tick
output.action: bias movement toward push_dir proportional to echo
output.failure: repeated shoves can create compulsive attraction to an aggressor

train.input: It should remember falling off an edge and become suspicious of travelling that way again, but the fear should fade while safely supported.

output.trigger: support contacts drop from nonzero to zero
output.update: store recent travel direction; increase fear; decay fear only while supported
output.action: bias movement opposite danger_dir while fear is high
output.failure: narrow platforms can produce oscillatory indecision

train.input: If it keeps trying to move but goes nowhere, I want a little three-part escape ritual: reverse, turn, then jump once.

output.trigger: commanded motion high while displacement stays low
output.update: accumulate jam; on threshold advance phase; reset after free movement
output.action: phase0 reverse briefly; phase1 turn sharply; phase2 jump once then reset
output.failure: soft obstacles can trigger unnecessary ritual loops

train.input: A robot that copies the direction of a nearby successful mover for a moment, like it borrows confidence from seeing someone else escape.

output.trigger: nearby actor accelerates successfully toward open space
output.update: store neighbour acceleration direction; raise confidence; decay without successful self-motion
output.action: bias movement along borrow_dir while confidence is high
output.failure: groups can stampede together into a newly appearing hazard

train.input: Big collisions should make it freeze up, and it only slowly recovers if the world stops hitting it.

output.trigger: collision impulse above threshold while moving
output.update: set freeze from impulse magnitude; decay only while contact forces stay low
output.action: suppress movement and turning proportional to freeze
output.failure: persistent jostling can lock the actor into immobility

train.input: After brushing a wall it should keep curving back toward the same side for a bit, almost like the wall left a scent.

output.update: remember contact side; increase trace; decay trace away from surfaces
output.action: curve toward remembered side proportional to trace
output.failure: one brush can make the actor orbit a convex obstacle

train.input: If its velocity suddenly changes direction without being commanded, it should lose confidence and probe left-right cautiously until motion becomes predictable again.

output.trigger: velocity direction changes sharply without matching command
output.state: expected_dir unit vector; confidence scalar 0..1; probe_side bit
output.update: lower confidence on mismatch; toggle probe_side; recover confidence during stable motion
output.action: reduce speed and apply small alternating probe turn while confidence is low
output.failure: rough terrain can cause endless cautious probing

train.input: It watches for motion crossing in front, charges up a pounce, then after jumping has a cooldown so it cannot instantly pounce again.

output.trigger: target-like local motion crosses forward sensor arc
output.update: increase charge while motion remains visible; after jump set refractory=1; decay refractory
output.action: jump forward when charge is high and refractory is zero
output.failure: periodic environmental motion can entrain repeated mistimed pounces

train.input: Make a coward that does not know about enemies globally. A sudden nearby loud impact makes it retreat from the impact point, and each quiet second lets it calm down.

output.update: store direction away from impact; raise panic; decay panic during quiet ticks
output.action: move along threat_dir proportional to panic
output.failure: repeated harmless impacts can drive it indefinitely away from useful areas

train.input: I want a creature that gets impatient at doors. Every time forward progress stalls near the same contact normal, it pushes harder, but this stubbornness should cap.

output.trigger: forward progress stalls while frontal contact persists
output.update: increase stubborn up to cap while same contact persists; decay after free motion
output.action: increase forward force proportional to stubborn
output.failure: it can waste effort shoving an immovable wall

train.input: A nervous hover bot should remember the last vertical wobble and overcorrect a little less each time, so it visibly settles.

output.trigger: vertical velocity changes sign outside deadband
output.update: store vertical error; set correction opposite error with bounded damping
output.action: apply vertical thrust from correction
output.failure: sensor noise can sustain small oscillations forever

train.input: Give a tracked bot a grudge against getting spun. If angular velocity spikes, remember the spin direction and bias torque against that direction for a short time.

output.update: store angular sign; set grudge=1; decay grudge each tick
output.action: apply bounded counter-torque opposite spin_sign proportional to grudge
output.failure: repeated alternating hits can make it twitch between counter-torques

train.input: A scavenger should linger around places where it recently found useful material, but the memory is only a local direction and fades.

output.update: store direction toward pickup location relative to actor; set scent=1; decay scent
output.action: when idle bias movement along return_dir proportional to scent
output.failure: it can revisit an already depleted patch repeatedly

train.input: If one foot loses contact while another stays planted, the walker should remember which side failed and step wider on that side for a few cycles.

output.update: store failed side; set caution=3; decrement after each stable step
output.action: increase outward step offset on weak_side while caution>0
output.failure: alternating slips can make its gait permanently wide and inefficient

train.input: A creature should become fascinated by repeated flashes. It counts nearby flashes up to four; at four it turns toward the last flash direction, then clears the count.

output.update: increment flash_count up to 4; store latest flash_dir; clear count after orient action
output.action: when flash_count=4 turn toward flash_dir
output.failure: regular machinery flashes can repeatedly steal its attention

train.input: When the bot squeezes through a narrow gap, remember the compression direction and stay slightly skinny in its posture for a short distance.

output.trigger: opposed side contacts indicate narrow passage
output.update: store compression axis; set memory=1; decay with travelled distance
output.action: reduce lateral posture span along squeeze_axis while memory is high
output.failure: it may stay narrow after exiting into a space where wider stance is safer

train.input: Make it hate sudden darkness. If local light drops quickly, it stops, remembers the direction it was moving, then resumes that way only after light stabilizes.

output.trigger: local luminance drops faster than threshold
output.update: store current travel direction; set hold=1; decay hold only when luminance is stable
output.action: stop while hold is high; then resume along resume_dir
output.failure: flickering lights can repeatedly freeze it

train.input: A little vehicle should remember the last slope it successfully climbed and lean into similar slopes for a while.

output.trigger: uphill motion succeeds above minimum speed
output.update: store local uphill direction; raise confidence; decay on flat terrain
output.action: bias body tilt and drive toward slope_dir when a similar local slope is sensed
output.failure: it can lean the wrong way when terrain orientation changes abruptly

train.input: After landing hard, the actor does one tiny rebound hop if it still has support. Never chain the rebound without a fresh landing.

output.trigger: landing impulse above threshold after airborne state
output.update: set rebound_ready on qualifying landing; clear immediately when used or support is lost
output.action: if rebound_ready and supported perform one bounded hop
output.failure: rapid bumpy contacts can look like nervous stuttering hops

train.input: If a wheel slips, remember the slip side and temporarily steer slightly away from it until traction comes back.

output.update: store slipping side; set avoidance from slip magnitude; decay when traction is stable
output.action: steer slightly away from slip_side proportional to avoidance
output.failure: alternating low-traction patches can produce a weaving path

train.input: A blob should remember the direction of the last sharp stretch and resist stretching that way again for a short time.

output.update: store stretch direction; set resistance=1; decay over time
output.action: bias internal contraction against stretch_dir proportional to resistance
output.failure: repeated impacts can make the blob temporarily rigid in several alternating poses

train.input: When it hears another actor collide nearby, it should pause for exactly two ticks before continuing whatever local movement it was already doing.

output.update: store current move direction; set pause_ticks=2; decrement each tick
output.action: wait while pause_ticks>0 then resume saved_dir
output.failure: dense collisions can keep resetting the pause and immobilize the actor

train.input: It should get excited by going fast downhill, remember that downhill direction briefly, and try to seek the same descent again.

output.trigger: speed rises while local slope is downhill
output.update: store downhill direction; increase excitement; decay when not descending
output.action: bias steering toward locally sensed slope matching descent_dir
output.failure: it can repeatedly choose a dangerous drop because the remembered descent was fast

train.input: If the actor bumps the same side three times close together, it should rotate away once and reset the count.

output.state: side left|right; bump_count integer 0..3; timer bounded
output.update: increment count for repeated same-side bumps within timer; otherwise reset side/count; clear after action
output.action: at count=3 perform one bounded turn away from side
output.failure: vibration against a wall can trigger periodic unnecessary turns

eval.input: After being pushed from behind, it should remember that direction and keep glancing or drifting back toward it until the memory fades.

output.update: store push direction; set memory=1; decay memory
output.action: bias orientation or movement toward push_dir proportional to memory
output.failure: frequent pushes can create obsessive backtracking

eval.input: If it loses traction while turning, I want it to become cautious about turning that same way for a few seconds.

output.update: store turn side; raise caution; decay with stable traction
output.action: reduce turn magnitude toward bad_turn while caution is high
output.failure: slippery alternating corners can make steering excessively timid

eval.input: A creature that keeps checking the last place it was startled from, but only with one fading directional memory.

output.update: store event direction; set vigilance=1; decay vigilance
output.action: periodically bias facing toward startle_dir while vigilance is high
output.failure: repeated harmless startles can keep it distracted from travel

eval.input: When forward motion gets blocked, it should remember which side had more free space and favor that side for the next two attempts.

output.update: choose side from local clearance; set attempts=2; decrement after each escape attempt
output.action: turn toward escape_side while attempts>0
output.failure: a moving obstacle can make the remembered side obsolete

eval.input: A jumper should get briefly shy after a hard landing and refuse another jump until the shyness fades.

output.update: set shy=1 on hard landing; decay shy each supported tick
output.action: suppress jump commands while shy is high
output.failure: rough ground can keep jump ability suppressed almost continuously

eval.input: It remembers the last warm direction it sensed and keeps drifting that way after the heat disappears, but only for a bounded time.

output.update: store heat-gradient direction; set warmth_memory=1; decay when gradient is absent
output.action: bias movement along warm_dir proportional to warmth_memory
output.failure: it can follow stale heat memory into a colder region
